messages:
sophie.partnerships: AuroraCompute uploaded the co-branded asset bundle for the cloud marketplace listing + 1-pager case study. Need fast QA on logos, color usage, and the one-line customer highlight. Can we review by Wed 12pm PT?

ankit.design: Quick skim: logo SVGs ok but their secondary gradient fails contrast in dark mode. Exported a flattened and a monochrome lockup in Figma: https://figma.com/file/ghijk/aurora-redwood-lockups. Recommend monochrome for small sizes and accessibility.

jess.marketing: Draft headline: "Redwood + AuroraCompute: inference on demand." Will post two headline/summary variants for marketplace meta (one benefit-forward, one conservative).

omar.prod: Case study cites "40% cost savings" but test used smaller model and batch=4. Suggest: "up to 40% for selected workloads" + add caption with test config: `Test harness: 16x A100 v4, model=redwood-medium, batch=4, dataset=standard-llm-testset`.

leah.legal: Need signed co-brand license and explicit customer consent for any quote. Marketplace also wants a disclaimer under customer results: "Results may vary; see full terms." I'll send addendum template.

infra-bot: Reminder: Marketplace asset checklist incomplete (missing signed license, accessibility checks). See: https://internal/docs/marketplace-checklist. Deadline 48h.

sophie.partnerships: Plan: ankit finalize exports, jess finalize copy, omar provide sanitized test caption, leah request signatures. Target upload Thu afternoon to submit by Fri. Scheduling 30-min sync Thu 10am PT to close. /remind me Thu 9am.
